title: Thi kisi ki dasht mein sadaa Haaye hum yateem hogaye
body:
Thi kisi ki dasht mein sadaa Haaye hum yateem hogaye
Fatima ka ghar ujadd gaya
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaaney kaisi shaam aagayi
Sab ko apney saath leygayi
Ek din mein kya sey kya huvaa
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kiski raah dekh aaye yeh ghareeb
Ban chukee hai tthokrein naseeb
Baap hai na sar pey ab chacha
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam jis jagaah huvee rukay
Subhaa hogayi toh chal padey
Hum musaafiroun ka kya rahaa
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kahoon kay kis tarhaa kiya
Zaalimoun ney baap ko shaheed
Dekhti rahi yeh Karbala
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Dukhtar-e-yateem ki dua
Gham na dey kisi ko ya Khuda
Beti ho na baap sey judaa
Haaye hum yateem hogaye
